step.cmd: With the document open in Microsoft Word, connect to X-Author Contracts.
Go to the X-Author Contracts pane > Start > Search Agreements.
In the Search Agreements field enter the full or partial agreement name and click the search icon to locate your agreement.
from the search result select the agreement name and click Check In Offline.

postreq.p: Your document is checked in offline and you can download the checked-in version of the agreement document. You can view the checked in agreement from Documents related list of your agreement record in Contract Management. The imported agreement does not have a template associated with it.
